version.changelog: Initial release: - source-level leading/trailing silence detection via take AudioAccessor - preserves internal pauses, breaths, weak tails and timeline positions - resets fades only on trimmed edges (2 ms / 5 ms by default) - optional preserve-existing-fades policy - ReaImGui live preview, right-click exact input, Run/Cancel - head/tail boundary navigation with centered arrange view - skips unsupported items and protects crossfades/overlaps - single undo block; batch-friendly
